headline: Thursday slate: ALCS Game 3 moved up to 10:00 AM PT for weather (Rays @ Guardians, tied 1-1), NLCS Game 4 (Brewers @ Dodgers, Milwaukee leads 3-0), Seahawks @ Broncos on Thursday Night Football, and a full NHL card.

record.label: Yesterday (Wed 10/14)
record.note: Milwaukee homered three times off Snell and won 6-2, so Dodgers -1.5, Snell Under 1.5 ER and the SGP all lost. Canadiens-Capitals went Over (5-4). The Contreras prop couldn't be confirmed.

notes: ALCS Game 3 starts at 10:00 AM PT — earlier than usual because of weather. Bet it first or skip it.
No bet is a lock. 'Confidence' runs 1–5, and nothing on this board is above a 3.
Where sources disagree on a game, we skip it or keep the stake small.
Odds move. Skip any pick whose price is past the 'playable to' number in its reasoning. Prices marked 'estimate' weren't confirmed at a book — check yours.

sections.label: Best of the Day
sections.slate: The strongest edges across today's card. Wednesday these went 1-2. Today: Glasnow's strikeouts at home, a low-scoring TNF, and the Rays in a pitching matchup that favors them.

straight.reasoning: Denver has gone Under in four of five games and scores only 19.4 a game (26th). Bo Nix completes just 35.4% of his passes under pressure, and Seattle generates the league's second-highest pressure rate and leads the NFL in yards per play allowed. The total has already dropped from 42.5. Risk: Seattle has scored 29+ in four straight, and Denver's secondary is missing Surtain. TheSpread's top play. Playable to 40.

Griffin Jax has held this Cleveland lineup to a .221 expected average and .256 xwOBA over 65 plate appearances, and Steven Kwan is 0-for-10 against him. Tampa hits right-handers much better (.751 OPS vs .678 against lefties), and Gavin Williams is a righty. The 98-win Rays are plus money. Covers' best bet. Playable to +100.

props.reasoning: He's gone over 5.5 in all six home starts this season (51 strikeouts in 36 home innings). Milwaukee has struck out 28.7% of the time over the last 30 days, and he struck out eight Brewers in 5.2 innings in last year's NLCS. Expensive, but the strongest trend on the board. Playable to -170.

sections.label: Baseball
sections.slate: ALCS Game 3: Rays @ Guardians at 10:00 AM PT (moved up for weather), Griffin Jax vs Gavin Williams, series tied 1-1. NLCS Game 4: Brewers @ Dodgers at 5:00 PM PT, Glasnow vs a likely Milwaukee bullpen game. Milwaukee leads 3-0 and can sweep.

straight.reasoning: Jax has dominated this lineup in a 65-PA sample, and Tampa hits righties well. Sources split on the total (one model likes the Over 6.5, SI likes a first-five Under), so we stick to the side. Playable to +100.

Facing elimination at home, with Glasnow against what's expected to be a Milwaukee bullpen game. SI's pick. Half a unit only. This lineup has scored six runs in three games, and we lost on the Dodgers last night. Playable to -175.

props.reasoning: Over 5.5 in all six home starts, against a Brewers lineup striking out 28.7% lately. Playable to -170.

sections.label: Football
sections.slate: Thursday Night Football: Seahawks @ Broncos, 5:15 PM PT on Prime Video. Seattle -2.5, total 40.5 (down from 42.5). Denver CB Patrick Surtain is out. Sources split on the side (Covers: Seattle -2.5; Yahoo: Denver +3.5), so we skip it.

straight.reasoning: Denver is 4-1 to the Under and scores 19.4 a game. Nix completes 35.4% of passes under pressure against a top-two pass rush. Playable to 40.

props.reasoning: He's topped 100 yards in four of five games (583 yards, 7 TDs), Denver is without Surtain and safety Hufanga, and Seattle's top two running backs are out. Quarter unit, since a big JSN night works against the Under.

sections.label: Hockey
sections.slate: Full Thursday card, most games at 4:00 PM PT, including Kraken @ Lightning, Canucks @ Panthers, Rangers @ Devils and Sabres @ Maple Leafs. Flames @ Golden Knights is at 7:00. Hockey is a 1-1 sport for this board this week, so these are small model-based plays.

straight.reasoning: Dimers' model gives Seattle a 56.3% chance to lose by one or win, a 3.8% edge. The Kraken beat Detroit 6-3 for us last week. Playable to -125.
Dimers' second-biggest edge of the day: 52.5% model probability against 47.4% implied, at plus money. Quarter unit.
